timestamp_policy: Pair CSV local file-write UTC; snapshot capture, not an exchange tick timestamp.

selection.order: descending; exact pair ID ascending on ties
selection.unique_key: base asset after removing USDT suffix from actual spot pair ID
selection.category_join: Exact base ticker; all candidates retained, never claim a unique project mapping when ambiguous.
selection.category_filter_caveat: Stablecoins is a source category/ecosystem tag, not proof the token itself is stable; USUAL is excluded by tag, not labelled intrinsically stable.
selection.unknown_policy: Missing category join or any empty category candidate excluded; no invented classifications.
